All industries ↗

Organize matter administration

Legal teams coordinate intake, documents, dates, research, review notes, assignments, and client communication. Nema can prepare that administrative work from the authorized records for one matter and bring the resulting brief into the team channel.

The responsible lawyers decide legal meaning and action. The firm sets the access, confidentiality, privilege, retention, provider, and professional-responsibility boundaries for the workflow.

Prepare matter intake

Provide the intake record, the firm's required fields, a party list, supplied documents, and the owner map. Nema can identify missing names, dates, records, scope information, and internal assignments.

The intake team decides whether the packet is complete and follows the firm's acceptance and conflict process. Nema gives the reviewers an organized list; it does not evaluate merits or communicate that a matter has been accepted.

Build a cited chronology

Using the selected matter documents, Nema can list events with the document title and page attached. It can keep conflicting dates side by side and call out undated or unclear records.

The lawyer verifies the chronology and decides which events matter. Because every entry points back to the document, the reviewer can correct a name, date, or characterization without reconstructing the whole file set.

Compare documents and review notes

Give Nema two agreement drafts, a defined comparison question, and the team's review template. It can identify changed language, omitted sections, dates, defined terms, and comments that remain open.

The lawyer interprets the changes and chooses the response. Nema can prepare a review queue without labeling a clause acceptable, risky, or legally effective.

Prepare the team handoff

From authorized notes, documents, and tasks, Nema can summarize completed administrative work, missing records, open questions, owners, and upcoming internal reviews. The incoming team member receives a clear starting point with source links.

Matter-specific information stays with its approved audience. The handoff supports continuity without replacing the document, docketing, or matter-management system.

Start with one chronology

Choose one authorized matter packet with a small set of documents, two conflicting dates, and one missing source. Ask Nema for the chronology and questions list. The responsible lawyer can edit it in Slack and use the corrected format for later handoffs.

The same source-linked format can support an internal review meeting. Nema can group unresolved document questions by owner, prepare the agenda, and record the follow-up that the lawyer states in the thread. The next handoff begins with those open items rather than another full read of the administrative history.

For recurring client or matter updates, the team can use an approved template and select only the facts appropriate for that audience. The responsible lawyer edits the draft and decides what can be shared.

Questions from legal services teams

Does Nema provide legal advice?

This workflow prepares administrative records and drafts. Qualified professionals provide analysis, advice, and client representation.

Can Nema calculate court or filing deadlines?

It can extract and cite dates or time periods for review. A lawyer determines the governing rule and final deadline.

How does a firm scope access?

Use matter-specific channels and approved sources, then apply the firm's controls for confidentiality, privilege, retention, security, and provider access.
